title: Host Hotels & Resorts Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call to be Held on November 5, 2026
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Host Hotels & Resorts Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.

BETHESDA, Md., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (NASDAQ: HST) (the “Company”), the nation’s largest lodging real estate investment trust, will report third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, after the market close.


The Company will hold a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 results and business outlook on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET. Conference call access information is as follows:


Conference Call:


USA/Canada Toll Free Number
833-461-5787


Conference ID
283070262


A simultaneous webcast of the call will be available on the Company’s website at[www.hosthotels.com](http://www.hosthotels.com/) .


A replay of the call will be available Thursday, November 5, 2026, until Wednesday, February 10, 2027, via webcast on the Company’s website.


**ABOUT HOST HOTELS & RESORTS**


Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. is an S&P 500 company and is the largest lodging real estate investment trust and one of the largest owners of luxury and upper-upscale hotels. The Company currently owns 70 properties in the United States and five properties internationally totaling approximately 41,300 rooms. The Company also holds non-controlling interests in seven domestic joint ventures.
